sentences.en: The medical team takes a holistic approach when treating patients.
sentences.zh: 医疗团队在治疗患者时采取整体性的方法。

sentences.en: Holistic medicine is largely unregulated so has a greater share of quacks.
sentences.zh: 整体医学监管不严，因此骗子医生的比例更高。

sentences.en: It is a stunning exhibition on wellness and holistic healing from awe-inspiring India.
sentences.zh: 这是一场来自令人惊叹的印度关于健康与整体疗愈的展览。

senses.zh: 全盘的，整体的,功能整体性的
